# fptcloud_object_storage_iam_user (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_object_storage_iam_user" "example" {
  vpc_id      = "your_vpc_id"
  region_name = "your_region_name"
  page        = 1
  page_size   = 100
}

output "list_iam_user" {
  value = data.fptcloud_object_storage_iam_user.example.list_iam_user
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region_name` (String) The region name that's are the same with the region name in the S3 service. Currently, we have: HCM-01, HCM-02, HN-01, HN-02
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC ID

### Optional

- `page` (Number) Page number
- `page_size` (Number) Number of items per page

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `list_iam_user` (List of Object) List of IAM users (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--list_iam_user))

<a id="nestedatt--list_iam_user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `list_iam_user`

Read-Only:

- `arn` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `path` (String)
- `user_id` (String)
- `user_name` (String)
